rules.a: equal split over the channel outputs, change pays nothing (main rule)
rules.a2: equal split, but payment batches (2+ non-channel outputs) split by size
rules.b: by value: every output, change included, pays in proportion to its amount
rules.c: by size: every output, change included, pays for its own vbytes plus a share of the rest
rules.whole: whole funding tx to each channel (upper bound)
